metadata.sql: SELECT Name, Country, Age FROM singer ORDER BY Age DESC
metadata.raw_question: Show name, country, age for all singers in descending order of age.

metadata.sql: SELECT Name, Capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 1
metadata.raw_question: Find the name and capacity for the stadium with highest average attendance.

metadata.sql: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT T1.Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.concert_ID = T2.concert_ID WHERE T2.Year = '2014')
metadata.raw_question: Find the names of singers who have not sung in any concert in year 2014.

metadata.sql: SELECT destairport FROM flights WHERE sourceairport = 'SFO' INTERSECT SELECT destairport FROM flights WHERE sourceairport = 'ORD'
metadata.raw_question: Find the destination airports that receive flights from both 'SFO' and 'ORD'.

metadata.sql: SELECT T1.airlinename FROM airlines AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airlineid = T2.airline GROUP BY T1.airlinename ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
metadata.raw_question: Which airline has the highest number of flights connecting international airports outside their home country?

metadata.sql: SELECT T1.title FROM publication AS T1 JOIN writes AS T2 ON T1.pid = T2.pid WHERE T1.year = 2021 GROUP BY T1.title HAVING count(T2.aid) > 10
metadata.raw_question: Find papers written by authors who have authored more than 10 papers in year 2021.
